gaps.term: inequality direction in the tau bound
gaps.note: The first inequality is false and the chain does not give what is needed. Since exp(-x) >= 1-x and ln mu < 20, mu^{-2^{-50}} is greater than 1-20*2^{-50}, not less. Lambda < mu^tau needs mu^{-2^{-50}} > 1-eta, which follows from mu^{-2^{-50}} > 1-20*2^{-50} > 1-eta (as eta > 20*2^{-40} > 20*2^{-50}). A chain 'a < b > c' proves nothing about a versus c.
The page never gives mu for the explicit network (nor W_b, s_b), and does not cite this bound, so the reader cannot check that mu < 2^20.

gaps.quote: A forward, inverse, forward schedule of these invocations exchanges the two banks
gaps.note: An inverse invocation is never defined on the page, and the claim is not tied to the three updates given earlier (D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D), whose third update is not a forward or inverse invocation. Three shears y+=x, x-=y, y+=x give (-y, x), an exchange only up to sign, so 'exchanges the two banks' is stated more strongly than it holds unless the sign is handled as in the earlier schedule.
